concerns.text: The three Edge Cases (insufficient window coverage → flag/interpolate/halt; batch-effect integration failure → detect via kBET/LISI and abort; permutation p=0 → report p < 1/N) have NO backing FRs or SCs. Add FRs (e.g., FR-011..FR-013) anchored to the relevant user stories so these behaviors are buildable and verifiable.

Constitution Principle VII and the idea's methodology ('Independence Check: validate findings against an independent dataset, e.g., bulk RNA-seq time courses') mandate cross-dataset validation of the disorder correlation, but no FR or SC covers independent-dataset replication. US-3's scope (statistical validation) plainly includes it; add an FR/SC (e.g., 'replication of enrichment signal in an independent cohort') anchored to US-3.
